result: corrected SMHC3-specific candidate passes static review; hardware acceptance pending
reviewed: DES0 only OWN31/FD3/LD2; low4G keeps high-address fields zero. CH4/DIC1/ER5/CES30 are not used because they are reserved for SMHC3.
DES1 size is 12 bits; 1KiB positive, four-byte-aligned chunks avoid zero (ignored) encoding. All addresses are word-shifted.
DMAC enables bit7 only; bit1 is reserved. IDST clears valid sticky bits with0x133 and errors use only4/5. No descriptor CES error interpretation.
RINTSTS13 is an error on reads, normal busy-clear on writes.18 is write-busy timeout;8/9/10/18 report timeout in the fixed legacy/no-voltage-switch scope.
CTRL31 selects DMA FIFO access, CTRL5 enables DMA; no new reserved30 modification. FIFO0x300f00f0 represents outstanding encoding3 (four requests), RX15/TX240.
Completion requires CMD_DONE plus DATA/ACMD_DONE, matching-direction IDST and every OWN clear. A descriptor-level RX/TX status alone cannot prematurely complete a request.
Coherent32-bit allocations bound data/descriptor addresses. dma_wmb before engine start and dma_rmb before ownership/data read enforce ordering.

Data requests always stop/disable/reset engine and FIFO before read-copy, success return or reuse. Reset timeout marks dead and pins allocations until reboot; no free/reuse after uncertain DMA quiescence.
Failed reads never copy bounce data; failed write SG copy occurs before engine enable. Zero bytes_xfered on failure.
Ordered workqueue serializes callbacks including requeue from mmc_request_done; callback ends immediately after completion.
Shared gates are read-only: resources020025e0/0200259c match corrected builder. Check bit30/bit0, reject before controller writes if off. Saved board values f1055803/00030001 and SMCV03050610 agree.
Reviewed actual C tests cover address/length boundaries, reserved-descriptor-bit zero, direction/command/data completion, OWN pending, read-vs-write bit13, timeout18/10 and error precedence.
